summary: Procure and onboard DataHarbor enterprise seats (VPC-enabled, SAML) for DataOps team
cost_estimate: $24,000/year (40 seats, enterprise plan + VPC addon, 12-month term)
vendor_info: DataHarbor Inc. — sales rep: Claire Mendes <claire.mendes@dataharbor.com>; Legal quote ID: DH-ENT-2026-114; SOC2 Type II available; supports customer-managed VPC with gateway appliance and KMS integration.
description:
Issue summary:
- Request to purchase 40 enterprise seats for DataHarbor and complete vendor onboarding for use by DataOps and Platform Reliability teams. Requirement: VPC-enabled deployment (private connectivity), SAML SSO via Okta, and optional KMS integration for key management.

Impact:
- DataOps team needs access for log retention/search and curated dataset management. Delay impacts scheduled Q2 model retraining runs (estimated ~3 engineer-weeks of delay per month if access not provisioned).

Request / Acceptance criteria:
- Purchase 40 seats on enterprise plan with VPC addon and 12-month term.
- Security signoff confirming SOC2 and encryption controls; completed security checklist in Confluence.
- Identity: SAML/SCIM setup with Okta and test users created.
- Network: VPC peering or private link validated with network team; egress rules and IP allowlist documented.
- Finance: PO issued and charged to cost center ENG-PLAT-230.
- Admin onboarding: two admin accounts provisioned and initial training scheduled.

Background / Business justification:
- DataHarbor provides schema-aware dataset cataloging and private search used by multiple platform services. DataOps has trialed the SaaS and confirmed integration with our ETL pipelines. Enterprise+VPC required for PHI-adjacent projects and to meet customer contractual requirements.

Steps required (high level):
1) Procurement: finalize quote, sign MSA addendum for VPC, request PO from Finance.
2) Security review: run vendor risk checklist, request penetration test evidence, confirm KMS & key rotation options.
3) Network: coordinate with Cloud Networking to provision VPC peering / PrivateLink and update firewall rules.
4) Identity: configure Okta SAML app and SCIM provisioning; test provisioning with sample group.
5) Onboarding: seat assignment, admin training session, update internal runbook, and tag cost center.

Attachments / Links:
- Vendor quote PDF (attached in Jira)
- Security checklist draft (Confluence link above)

Notes: vendor can start setup in staging VPC while legal finalizes the addendum. Procurement needs Finance PO number before production VPC is established.
investigation_notes: Initial checks done by IT procurement on 2026-03-11: verified SOC2 attestation, requested pen-test report (vendor to deliver by 2026-03-12). Network team raised two questions around allowable egress endpoints (ticket opened with Cloud Networking). Confirmed DataHarbor supports customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS key ARN. Estimated lead time for VPC integration: 7-10 business days after PO and security signoff.
